claim.en: In December 2023 MP Michal Sabo (PS) gave up his mandates in the Bratislava city council and the Petržalka local council.
claim.sk: V decembri 2023 sa poslanec NR SR Michal Sabo (PS) vzdal mandátu v bratislavskom mestskom i petržalskom miestnom zastupiteľstve.
